description: BikeshareClient is a C# client for General Bikeshare Feed Specification services. Its README says it supports required GBFS fields and names public bicycle-share deployments in Trondheim and Bergen as examples. Users point the client at a compatible operator feed; outputs include structured station, availability or system information exposed by that feed. Geographic coverage follows the operator selected, with no fixed global dataset. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client. A limitation is that GBFS reflects current availability and feed quality, not realised trips, demand or route safety. Operator API terms and polling limits must be checked separately. BikeshareClient can prepare station-capacity and availability inputs for active-mobility or public-transit simulation. The related catalogue AequilibraE record models transport networks but does not provide this live-feed client. No operator feed or package was downloaded.
name: BikeshareClient GBFS live-feed client
